introHtml: Valu Mark koozies offer a budget-friendly option for keeping beverages cold at your next corporate event or trade show. Made with durable foam construction, these koozies provide reliable insulation while offering a large printable area for your logo or message. Choose from a variety of colors to match your brand, and decorate with screen printing or full-color imprint. Perfect for marketing directors and safety managers looking for cost-effective promotional giveaways that get noticed.
